The orientation of three points p, q, r can be determined by computing the cross product of vectors pq and pr. The sign of the cross product determines the orientation:

- If cross product > 0: left turn (LEFT_TURN)
- If cross product < 0: right turn (RIGHT_TURN)  
- If cross product = 0: collinear (COLLINEAR)

The cross product for vectors pq and pr is: (q.x() - p.x()) * (r.y() - p.y()) - (q.y() - p.y()) * (r.x() - p.x())
